hostTests.purpose: Validate all package-bearing whole documents through the shared schemas.

scenarios: The F# frontend in the store
An interrupted unpack is never selected
Collection cannot run between publication and recording
hostTests.purpose: Use the real store, owner lock and journal; inject interruption at each publication boundary.

scenarios: A guest that writes beside itself
hostTests.purpose: Start a guest on Unix and verify directory mode 0555 prevents its write.

scenarios: A scanner holds a new file open
hostTests.purpose: Hold a Windows file open and verify no-replace publication retries for at most ten seconds.

scenarios: A corrupt tree with a live lease is left unchanged
A same-size changed tree is not reused at install
Repair retains the existing lease file
hostTests.purpose: With a real guest holding the shared lease, corrupt one byte without changing size. Install fully hashes the existing tree, refuses repair immediately with package.publish_busy, and leaves tree, modes, manifest, lease identity, lock and catalog unchanged. After guest exit, exclusive nonwaiting repair retains the same lease file identity, replaces the tree from verified staging and records only verified bytes.
Attempt a real cross-volume rename; verify no copy or recording occurs.

scenarios: Starting the F# frontend
hostTests.purpose: Observe absolute argv[0], locked arguments and project working directory in the started guest.

scenarios: A changed byte is found on request
hostTests.purpose: Modify one byte without changing size; explicit full verification reports package.tree_changed with its path.

scenarios: A long user name on Windows
hostTests.purpose: Check real absolute UTF-16 file and directory limits before publication.

scenarios: Two sessions share a package
The host crashes while its guest runs on Unix
A guest leaves a child behind
Uninstall while running
A package in use is kept
hostTests.purpose: Two processes, inherited Unix lease and process group, or Windows no-breakaway job; collection retains every live leased tree.

scenarios: A home with a toolchain generation
hostTests.purpose: Put a real generation receipt under toolchains/generations and verify explicit collection removes nothing.

scenarios: A signed executable inside an unsigned release
hostTests.purpose: Use a signed entry point from unauthenticated local content; verify signatures inside the archive grant no publisher trust.
